Order 
This is fourth application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nargik Surkasha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 18.4.2023 in connection with Crime No. 189/2023, registered at Police Station Rahli District Sagar for the offence punishable under Sections 405, 420, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that looking to the long period of custody and offence is punishable with 7 years of imprisonment, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
Advocate for the State as well counsel for the objector have opposed the prayer and submitted that applicant is habitual offender and two more cases are registered against the applicant.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be enlarged on bail.
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
